definitions: The view of the sky, often including the skyline

blocks.text: Skyscape art depicts representations of the sky, especially in a painting or photograph. Skyscapes differ from cloudscapes because they do not necessarily include clouds. Like cloudscape art, skyscape art can also omit any view of land or anything else which might help to suggest scale or orientation. Images called "skyscapes" often do include clouds or land, but these things can also be excluded or kept to a minimum.

images.alt: The constellation mural at Grand Central Terminal in New York City is an example of skyscape art.
